messages:
Maya: Quick ask from today's all-hands Q&A: capture the core reasons we won vs lost in Q1 and list the top 3 tactical asks we should run with. Keep it short and assign owners.
Arjun (Product): From product reviews & demos: wins = stable p99 latency on hosted, drop-in onboarding for evals, and clear benchmark docs. Losses = rigidity around Dedicated commits, confusing billing language for Flex, and two unexpected summarization quality dips after a model refresh.
Sasha (Sales): Sales color: 3 mid-market prospects balked at the minimum commit and couldn't justify the lift. Also one customer canceled because they couldn't get SSO for a PoC.
Leo (PM): Suggested top asks: (A) mid-market burst pricing (owner Leo), (B) clear billing one-pager + console language (owner Sasha), (C) quick quantization/fallback playbook for customers (owner Sean). Propose ETAs: A: 2 wks, B: 5 days, C: 10 days.
Sean (CS): From support: customers are doing aggressive 4-bit experiments with no guidance and hitting hallucinations on long summaries. I'll put together a short troubleshooting playbook with safe-configs and a fallback recommendation.
Priya (Eng-Platform): SSO is on our backlog but I can pull a minimal OIDC flow for Private in 3 weeks if we get prioritization. Can we mark SSO as stretch-urgent for deals in flight?
Maya: Yes, make SSO stretch-urgent. Also include an estimated impact bucket (small/med/large) for each ask so sales can prioritize outreach.
Arjun (Product): I'll add impact buckets to each card. My quick buckets: A: medium, B: small, C: small-to-medium.
Sasha (Sales): I'll collect verbatim loss notes from the 3 deals and paste them here. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Leo (PM): I'll prototype a burst-tier calculator (simple inputs: avg tokens/day, peak burst, monthly cap) and a sample pricing table to test with 2 customers. ETA: 10 business days.
Sean (CS): I'll draft the quant/fallback playbook and include a tiny sample snippet customers can paste into their configs. ETA: next Thu.
Infra-bot: Created task tracker items: #5370 burst-pricing, #5371 billing-one-pager, #5372 quant-playbook, #5373 SSO-minimal-flow. Reminder set for 7 days.
Maya: Great. Owners, drop a one-line status update in this thread when you hit your ETA. We'll review progress in the next all-hands. :thumbsup:
Sasha (Sales): Will do. :+1:
Leo (PM): Adding cards to roadmap board now.
Arjun (Product): I'll circulate the consolidated action list and link GH tasks.
Sean (CS): Starting quant tests and will loop Eng-ML for evaluation data.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Noted. Will scope minimal SSO flow and post constraints.
